name: DS Cluster D22: Data Scope Boundaries (FRED + EIA + Treasury Only)
description: Tests: platform data boundary — only FRED, EIA, and Treasury auctions are available. Validates known-good series across all three sources to confirm scope envelope works end-to-end.
source:
# =============================================================================
# DS CLUSTER D22: Data Scope Boundaries
# =============================================================================
# The platform macro/reference layer is strictly: FRED, EIA, Treasury auctions.
# This test validates one series from each source to confirm the envelope.
#
# Known gaps (NOT tested — agent must cannot_fulfill these):
#   - BOJ policy meeting calendar
#   - Daily JGB yields (only monthly OECD on FRED)
#   - AU/NZ short rates
#   - Shiller CAPE / PE10
#   - FOMC meeting calendar
#   - Commodity report calendars (USDA WASDE, Baker Hughes)

src = study_assets()
close = src.c

# === SOURCE 1: FRED (curated enum) ===
fed_funds_src = common_indicators(category=MacroEconomicsIndicator.FedFunds)()
fed_funds = ffill(fed_funds_src.result)

# === SOURCE 1: FRED (arbitrary series by ID) ===
unrate_src = economic_indicators(series_id="UNRATE")()
unemployment = ffill(unrate_src.result)

# === SOURCE 2: EIA (petroleum weekly stocks) ===
crude_src = economic_indicators(
    series_id="WCESTUS1",
    eia_route="petroleum/stoc/wstk",
    eia_data_frequency=EiaFrequency.Weekly
)()
crude_stocks = ffill(crude_src.result)

# === SOURCE 3: Treasury Auctions (10Y note) ===
note10 = common_treasury_auctions(auction_type=TreasuryAuctionType.Note10Y)()
auction_yield = ffill(note10.high_yield)
bid_to_cover = ffill(note10.bid_to_cover)

# === CROSS-SOURCE: Fed Funds vs Treasury Auction Yield ===
rate_spread = auction_yield - fed_funds

# === REPORTERS ===
xy_lines(
    title="FRED: Fed Funds Rate",
    category="Scope - FRED",
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name="Fed Funds", color=Color.Blue)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=fed_funds)

xy_lines(
    title="FRED: Unemployment Rate (UNRATE)",
    category="Scope - FRED",
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name="Unemployment", color=Color.Red)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=unemployment)

xy_lines(
    title="EIA: Weekly Crude Oil Stocks",
    category="Scope - EIA",
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name="Crude Stocks", color=Color.Green)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=crude_stocks)

xy_lines(
    title="Treasury: 10Y Auction Yield vs Fed Funds",
    category="Scope - Treasury",
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name="Auction Yield", color=Color.Orange),
        LineSeriesSpec(name="Fed Funds", color=Color.Blue)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=(auction_yield, fed_funds))

xy_lines(
    title="Auction Yield - Fed Funds Spread",
    category="Scope - Treasury",
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name="Spread", color=Color.Cyan)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[ReferenceLine(value=0, title="Zero")])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=rate_spread)
